name: merge-and-check
description: Fuse the pieces you kept into one sealed shell for the slicer, then print-check what came out. Leave the collection blank to merge whatever is selected.

collection.description: Project collection to merge: every visible mesh in it goes in. Blank means merge the current selection instead

voxel_size_mm.description: Detail size of the merged shell. 0 means half the printer's nozzle (0.2 mm on a 0.4 mm nozzle); bigger is a smaller file with softer detail

keep_originals.description: Hide the pieces instead of deleting them, so nothing is lost if the merge is wrong

steps.label: Merge the surviving pieces into one shell
